headline: Uber Technologies (UBER) Lands Licensed Autonomous Rides In London With 100,000 Sign Ups
summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) plans to launch licensed autonomous rides in London in partnership with AI startup Wayve, marking its first such deployment in a major global city. The London service will use a hybrid model that pairs AI-driven vehicles with safety certified human drivers to meet local regulatory requirements. More than 100,000 London residents have joined a sign-up list for the service, highlighting strong public interest in Uber's autonomous offering. The move positions Uber...
